text: I usually make coffee before I check my phone in the morning.
translation: 저는 보통 아침에 휴대폰을 확인하기 전에 커피를 만들어요.

text: I was running late this morning, so I grabbed something quick and headed straight out the door.
translation: 오늘 아침에는 늦어서 간단히 먹을 것을 챙기고 바로 집을 나섰어요.

text: I had every intention of getting an early start, but I somehow ended up wasting half the morning on little things.
useful_expression: have every intention of / end up -ing
translation: 일찍 하루를 시작할 생각이었는데, 어쩌다 보니 사소한 일들에 오전 절반을 써버렸어요.

text: By the time I realized how much time I had burned, the whole morning had pretty much gotten away from me.
translation: 시간을 얼마나 허비했는지 깨달았을 때는 이미 오전이 거의 다 지나가 버린 뒤였어요.

text: My manager gave me some helpful advice before the meeting.
translation: 회의 전에 매니저가 도움이 되는 조언을 해줬어요.

text: I was not sure how to handle the situation, so my manager talked me through what I needed to do.
translation: 어떻게 대처해야 할지 몰라서 매니저가 제가 해야 할 일을 차근차근 설명해줬어요.

text: Even though I had prepared for the presentation, I ended up improvising when several unexpected questions came up.
translation: 발표 준비를 했는데도 예상치 못한 질문이 여러 개 나오자 결국 즉석에서 대응하게 됐어요.

text: Looking back, I probably overthought the whole thing, because once the conversation got going, everything fell into place naturally.
translation: 돌이켜보면 제가 너무 많이 고민했던 것 같아요. 막상 대화가 시작되니 모든 게 자연스럽게 풀렸거든요.

text: My best friend always knows how to make me feel better.
translation: 제 가장 친한 친구는 언제나 제가 기분이 나아지게 하는 법을 알아요.

text: We did not agree at first, but we talked it out and eventually understood where the other person was coming from.
useful_expression: talk it out / see where someone is coming from
translation: 처음에는 의견이 달랐지만 충분히 이야기한 끝에 결국 서로의 입장을 이해하게 됐어요.

text: I did not want to make a big deal out of it, but the way she brushed off my concern honestly bothered me.
useful_expression: make a big deal out of / brush off
translation: 큰일로 만들고 싶지는 않았지만, 그 사람이 제 걱정을 대수롭지 않게 넘긴 태도는 솔직히 신경이 쓰였어요.

text: We have known each other long enough to tell when something is off, even if neither of us says it out loud.
translation: 우리는 서로 오래 알아서, 아무 말도 하지 않아도 뭔가 이상할 때를 알아차릴 수 있어요.

text: Our hotel was close to the station, so getting around was easy.
translation: 호텔이 역과 가까워서 이동하기 편했어요.

text: Our flight was delayed, but the airline staff kept us updated and helped us figure out our options.
translation: 비행기가 지연됐지만 항공사 직원들이 계속 상황을 알려주고 가능한 방법을 찾도록 도와줬어요.

text: We almost missed the last train because we underestimated how long it would take to get back across town.
translation: 도시 반대편에서 돌아오는 데 걸리는 시간을 과소평가해서 막차를 놓칠 뻔했어요.

text: The trip did not go exactly according to plan, but those unexpected detours ended up being the parts we talked about most.
translation: 여행이 계획대로 흘러가지는 않았지만, 뜻밖의 우회가 오히려 가장 오래 이야기하게 된 추억이 됐어요.

text: I ordered the pasta because the waiter said it was popular.
translation: 웨이터가 인기 메뉴라고 해서 파스타를 주문했어요.

text: The place was packed, but the food came out quickly and everything tasted much better than I expected.
translation: 식당은 꽉 차 있었지만 음식은 빨리 나왔고, 모든 메뉴가 생각보다 훨씬 맛있었어요.

text: I usually play it safe when I order, but this time I went with the server recommendation and was pleasantly surprised.
translation: 평소에는 익숙한 메뉴를 고르는 편인데, 이번에는 직원 추천을 따라갔다가 기분 좋게 놀랐어요.

text: The dish sounded a little strange on paper, but all the flavors somehow came together without any one ingredient taking over.
translation: 메뉴 설명만 보면 조금 이상해 보였지만, 어느 한 재료도 튀지 않고 모든 맛이 자연스럽게 어우러졌어요.

text: I felt tired all day, so I decided to go to bed early.
translation: 하루 종일 피곤해서 일찍 자야겠다고 생각했어요.

text: I thought the treatment would be uncomfortable, but the therapist talked me through the whole process and made everything feel much easier.
translation: 치료가 불편할 줄 알았지만, 치료사가 전 과정을 차근차근 설명해줘서 훨씬 편하게 느껴졌어요.

text: Even though the swelling usually goes down within a few days, you should contact the clinic if anything feels unusually painful or difficult to manage.
translation: 붓기는 보통 며칠 안에 가라앉지만, 유난히 아프거나 감당하기 어려운 느낌이 들면 병원에 연락해야 해요.

text: I had been putting off the appointment for weeks, mostly because I was worried they would tell me something I did not want to hear.
translation: 몇 주 동안 진료 예약을 미루고 있었어요. 듣고 싶지 않은 말을 들을까 봐 걱정됐던 게 가장 큰 이유였어요.

text: I asked for a different size because this one was too small.
translation: 이건 너무 작아서 다른 사이즈를 요청했어요.

text: The item looked different from the photos, so I contacted customer service and asked if I could return it.
useful_expression: contact customer service / return an item
translation: 상품이 사진과 달라 보여서 고객센터에 연락해 반품할 수 있는지 물어봤어요.

text: I was ready to give up on the order, but the support agent sorted everything out faster than I expected.
translation: 주문을 포기하려던 참이었는데, 상담원이 생각보다 훨씬 빨리 문제를 해결해줬어요.

text: The refund process was surprisingly painless, which honestly made me more willing to shop with them again.
translation: 환불 과정이 놀랄 만큼 간단해서 오히려 그곳에서 다시 쇼핑할 마음이 생겼어요.

text: I need a little more time before I make a decision.
translation: 결정하기 전에 시간이 조금 더 필요해요.

text: There are three things you should think about before making a decision: the possible risks, the expected results, and the amount of recovery time.
translation: 결정하기 전에 세 가지를 생각해봐야 해요. 가능한 위험, 예상되는 결과, 그리고 회복에 필요한 시간이요.

text: I can see why the idea sounds appealing, but I am not convinced the benefits outweigh the potential downsides.
translation: 왜 그 아이디어가 매력적으로 들리는지는 알겠지만, 장점이 잠재적인 단점보다 크다고는 확신하지 않아요.

text: I was on the fence at first, but once I looked at the bigger picture, the decision became a lot easier to justify.
useful_expression: be on the fence / look at the bigger picture
translation: 처음에는 결정을 못 하고 있었지만, 큰 그림을 보고 나니 그 선택이 훨씬 납득하기 쉬워졌어요.

text: I met a few new people at the party last night.
translation: 어젯밤 파티에서 새로운 사람 몇 명을 만났어요.

text: I did not know many people there, so I started a conversation with someone standing next to me.
translation: 아는 사람이 많지 않아서 옆에 서 있던 사람에게 먼저 말을 걸었어요.

text: I am usually awkward at networking events, but once I get past the small talk, I actually enjoy meeting people.
translation: 저는 보통 네트워킹 행사에서 어색해하지만, 가벼운 대화를 넘기고 나면 사람 만나는 걸 꽤 즐겨요.

text: The conversation could have been uncomfortable, but she had a way of putting everyone at ease without trying too hard.
translation: 어색해질 수도 있는 대화였지만, 그 사람은 애쓰는 티 없이 모두를 편하게 만드는 재주가 있었어요.

text: I lost my phone once, but someone found it and called me.
translation: 예전에 휴대폰을 잃어버린 적이 있는데, 누군가 찾아서 제게 연락해줬어요.

text: I thought I had ruined the whole trip, but what happened next turned into one of my favorite memories.
translation: 여행을 완전히 망쳤다고 생각했는데, 그다음에 벌어진 일이 가장 좋아하는 추억 중 하나가 됐어요.

text: At the time it felt like a complete disaster, but looking back, it taught me to stay calm when things do not go as planned.
translation: 그때는 완전한 재앙처럼 느껴졌지만, 돌이켜보면 일이 계획대로 되지 않을 때 침착함을 유지하는 법을 배웠어요.

text: The funny thing is that I barely remember what went wrong anymore, but I can still picture exactly how everyone reacted.
useful_expression: the funny thing is / go wrong
translation: 재미있는 건 이제는 뭐가 잘못됐는지 거의 기억도 안 나는데, 모두가 어떻게 반응했는지는 아직도 선명하게 떠오른다는 거예요.
